name: LWS Knitwear Limited
about: LWS Knitwear Limited manufactures and sells knitted clothes, hosiery goods and readymade garments in India. The company offers woolen and acrylic garments; and winter and summer wear garments for men, women, and children, including flat knit sweaters, circular knit t-shirts, hooded t-shirts, sweatshirts, knitted bottoms, knitted sleepwear, cardigans, woolen mufflers, and joggers. The company also trades in knitted apparel, including readymade knitted t-shirts. In addition, the company sells its products under the LWS brand, as well as under third party brands. Further, it exports hosiery goods to the Middle East, Europe, and the United States. LWS Knitwear Limited was founded in 1976 and is based in Ludhiana, India.
